strategy_audience.audience_name: Founder-led digital, web, development, and creative agencies
strategy_audience.selected_problem: Client delivery displaces consistent market presence.
decision_factors: The system must preserve the agency's actual expertise and voice.
Claims must remain traceable to current evidence and real work.
The process must reduce owner drafting effort without publishing generic filler.
Wix and LinkedIn output must be independently useful and platform-appropriate.
objections: An automated system will sound generic or unlike the agency.
Maintaining the system may consume as much time as writing manually.
Content activity may not produce commercially meaningful conversations.
